proves: A stable single-model misread is caught by a SECOND model and never lands. Both readings are observed live, not invented: haiku 99.0 vs sonnet 90.0 on an image that says $90.00, at a size well above the documented accuracy floor so 'too small to read' is excluded. The disagreement discards the value (validation_failed, needs_review) rather than landing either reading. invoice_ref agrees and stays ok, with evidence still evidence_unverified because agreement is corroboration, not verification.
